method: Original GitHub REST issue bodies for every reviewed post, fetched 2026-10-31 through the authenticated API; labels, state, comment counters and updated_at as reported at fetch time. Conversation comments were NOT re-collected in this round; their archive remains the 2026-10-20 conversation snapshot. Linked external pages, review threads and removed history are not included. Each record's archive_sha256 is the canonical sorted-key UTF-8 JSON of the fields fetched plus a newline. Collection is not semantic review; the verdicts are this batch's work.
review_method: Every body was read. A verdict is one of: reviewed-deferred with the reason the transformation is unsound, unrepresentable in this IR, owned by another layer, or needs an instruction the 1-to-1 bit_idioms matcher cannot insert. None of the 151 is claimed as covered: the two folds this batch ships (a shift-pair mask and the {0,1} membership threshold) were found by the campaign's own probe corpus, and no report in this snapshot isolates them.

folds.name: shl_lshr_mask
folds.measured: 4 -> 3 instructions on x86-64 at -O2, matching GCC 16.2 (was one move longer)
folds.history: The first draft masked with 2^k - 1 and was wrong for every x with a bit at or above k; the GCC/Clang value differential caught it, and the exhaustive 8/16-bit test now compares against the pair's own evaluation.

folds.name: zero_one_membership
folds.measured: 9 -> 4 instructions on the bitwise spelling, matching GCC 16.2; the short-circuit spelling is unchanged because if-conversion has already turned it into a select tree before this pass, which is recorded as remaining work
folds.history: `memb_control` (x == 0 | x == 2) is the negative control: it is one constant away and must keep both comparisons.

records.title: Struct-returning const functions do not benefit from being const
records.review_note: IPO: const-returning struct functions miss the `const` benefit; needs aggregate return-value analysis, not a peephole.

records.title: Argpromotion does not handle first class aggregates
records.review_note: Argpromotion refuses first-class aggregates; a calling-convention/ABI change, not a local fold.

records.title: x86-32: clang could avoid byval in more cases
records.review_note: x86-32 byval elision depends on the 32-bit ABI's stack layout; i686 backend has no byval model to extend yet.

records.title: need store motion for partial dead stores
records.review_note: Partial dead-store motion needs store liveness across blocks; the memory SSA this repo has is block-local.

records.title: loop pass manager issue prevents loops from being flattened
records.review_note: Loop flattening blocked by the loop pass manager; LCCC's CFG pipeline flattens single-block loops only.

records.title: [x86-64] optimize va_start when there are no XMM vaarg calls
records.review_note: va_start without XMM varargs: the x86-64 SysV prologue always saves the full register file; a prologue-reshape item.

records.title: Failure to simplify SIMD vector conversion.
records.review_note: SIMD vector conversion folding is a vector-combine scope; scalar folds do not admit vector carriers here.

records.title: std::gcd and std::lcm doesn't precalculate in compile-time
records.review_note: std::gcd/lcm compile-time evaluation is constexpr front-end work, not an optimizer fold.

records.title: Loop Vectorizer does not handle masked gather
records.review_note: Masked gather lowering needs AVX2/AVX-512 gather selection; out of the SSE2 baseline this backend targets.

records.title: Failure to vectorize simple loop to AVX vpaddb
records.review_note: vpaddb requires AVX2 256-bit byte vectorization; the SSE2 baseline has no 256-bit form to select.

records.title: [InstCombine][X86] Narrow comparison fails to reuse an already needed mask
records.review_note: Narrow-comparison mask reuse is x86 selection on 64-bit masks; LCCC's mask narrowing is the batch-4 subject, not this.

records.title: [X86] Poor v8f16 fadd handling on non-vlx avx512fp16 targets
records.review_note: v8f16 fadd on non-vlx AVX512-FP16 is target-feature selection for an ISA LCCC does not emit.

records.title: [IndVarSimplify] Bounds check `i - 1 u< smax(n, 0)` not eliminated when the loop guard is `n s< 1`
records.review_note: IndVarSimplify bounds-check elimination needs signed-range loop guards; LCCC's induction analysis is affine-only.

records.title: # [X86][LoopVectorize] 16x16 SAD loop ~6x slower with -march=x86-64-v3: LV vectorizes the row loop with scalarized i8 loads instead of leaving it to SLP (regression since Clang 18)
records.review_note: SAD-loop vectorization is a vectorizer cost-model item; LCCC has no loop vectorizer for this shape.

records.title: [X86] Tail call that forwards the sret pointer is missed outside the entry block
records.review_note: sret tail call outside the entry block needs sret-parameter matching plus tail-position proof; deferred.

records.title: [X86] Branch on the borrow of a 2-word subtraction is split into two branches
records.review_note: Two-word subtraction borrow branch is a 128-bit/ADC pattern; LCCC's i128 lowering is library-call based.

records.title: [InstCombine] Dead disjunct not removed when implied false by a later conjunct
records.review_note: Dead disjunct implied false by a later conjunct: boolean implication across conjuncts. The 2026-10-31 audit added the neighbouring {0,1} comparator set; this implication rule remains deferred.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed XOR fold for (x != C) & ((x & 1) == 0) with even C
records.review_note: XOR fold for `(x != C) & ((x & 1) == 0)` with even C. LCCC already folds the odd-C case (probe: 4 instructions); the even-C form needs parity reasoning over the constant set, deferred.

records.title: Sub-optimal code generation around GC statepoints -  Unnecessary spills of GC pointers
records.review_note: GC statepoint spills are a calling-convention/regalloc item for a feature LCCC does not implement.

records.title: [AArch64] Missed folding opportunity for (sub b, (sra (shl a, C1), C2))
records.review_note: AArch64 sub-with-shifted-sign-extend folding is a target addressing-mode item; the x86 form needs the same sext-fold, deferred.

records.title: [SROA] Inlined cursor factory keeps an invariant field packed into the loop state
records.review_note: SROA keeping an invariant field packed: needs aggregate scalar replacement across an inlined cursor, deferred.

records.title: [SelectionDAG][X86] Branch merging counts work from the previous loop iteration as the cost of the second condition
records.review_note: Branch merging costed from the previous iteration is a SelectionDAG branch-folding heuristic, not a scalar identity.

records.title: [X86] Constant-mask i128 field updates miss narrowing to byte/dword stores
records.review_note: i128 constant-mask field narrowing to byte/dword stores: a real gap, but i128 lowering here is call-based; deferred.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed absolute-difference fold with a narrowed comparison
records.review_note: Absolute difference with a narrowed comparison: LCCC also emits the compare/select pair (8 vs 7 instructions). Needs an abs-diff canonical form, deferred.

records.title: [InstCombine] invariant.load dropped when unpacking array loads
records.review_note: invariant.load propagation through array unpacking is a metadata-fidelity item; LCCC has no invariant.load.

records.title: [LibCallsShrinkWrap] Dead tan() calls are not shrink-wrapped like sin()/cos()
records.review_note: Dead tan() shrink-wrapping is a libcall-shrinkwrap item; LCCC removes dead pure calls only when the call is provably side-effect free.

records.title: SCEV unable to determine trip count in straightforward loop with `switch` exit
records.review_note: SCEV trip count with a switch exit: LCCC's SCEV is affine and does not reason over switch successors.

records.title: [X86][LoopIdiomVectorize] hot loop in spec2017 557.xz not vectorized
records.review_note: xz hot-loop non-vectorization is a loop-idiom/vectorizer item, not a scalar fold.

records.title: [X86] sitofp/uitofp i128 to half shouldn't emit libcalls
records.review_note: sitofp/uitofp i128 to half without libcalls is a conversion-selection item for a type LCCC lowers via calls.

records.title: [InstCombine] sin+cos>sincos fusion shouldn't depend on no errno
records.review_note: sin+cos to sincos fusion is a libcall transform gated on errno; LCCC does not fuse math libcalls.

records.title: [RegAlloc][X86] CSR first-use split leaves copies when the CSR gets used anyway
records.review_note: CSR first-use split leaving copies is a register allocator cost-model item, not a peephole.

records.title: [InstCombine] ((x + C) & M) - C not folded to x & M when the add has other uses
records.review_note: `((x + C) & M) - C` to `x & M`: the identity needs a no-carry proof from the low bits; measured LCCC already matches GCC on the honest cases (4 vs 4) and the add-carry counter-example makes the general rule unsound, deferred.

records.title: [SCEV] Conditions on switch edges are not used as loop guards
records.review_note: SCEV switch-edge guards: same SCEV limitation as #234896.

records.title: [SimpleLoopUnswitch] Branchless select is unswitched into a branch at -O3
records.review_note: SimpleLoopUnswitch turning a select into a branch is a branch/select cost decision; LCCC's unswitching keeps selects.

records.title: [CVP] Flags derived from an assume let InstCombine weaken that assume
records.review_note: CVP flags weakening an assume is a range-fact provenance item; LCCC keeps assume facts block-local.

records.title: [SimplifyCFG] Switch case to unreachable is removed without an assume
records.review_note: SimplifyCFG switch-to-unreachable needs reachability from an assume; the same provenance item as #235798.

records.title: [InstCombine] Fold zero passthrough into masked gather through freeze
records.review_note: Masked-gather zero passthrough through freeze: no freeze in LCCC's IR and no masked gather.

records.title: Teach `frem` that `frem(x, y)` == `frem(x, -y)`
records.review_note: frem(x, -y) == frem(x, y): correct for the sign of y, but LCCC lowers frem to a libcall; the fold would only move work into the call.

records.title: [X86] Optimize `pdep(1 << n, mask)` without `bmi2` or with `slow-pdep`
records.review_note: pdep without BMI2 is a target-ISA expansion; LCCC's pdep is a BMI2-only builtin with a declared-unsupported fallback.

records.title: [CodeGenPrepare] `if (a && b) [[likely]]` is no longer two branches since clang 22
records.review_note: CodeGenPrepare likely-branch shape is a CFG/layout policy item.

records.title: [X86] Inefficient encoding of ctlz.128
records.review_note: ctlz.128 encoding: i128 lowering is call-based here; the ILP shape does not exist locally.

records.title: [X86] CRC loop clmul optimization performs extra GPR/XMM moves
records.review_note: CRC clmul extra moves are register-allocation quality on a PCLMUL path LCCC emits with a fixed shape.

records.title: [InstCombine] foldCmpLoadFromIndexedGlobal: stride guard from #234187 is over-conservative for nuw GEPs (missed optimization regression)
records.review_note: foldCmpLoadFromIndexedGlobal stride guard: needs global initializer analysis, which this repo has for const arrays only.

records.title: Logical reduction in C stopped vectorizing between 22 and 23
records.review_note: Vectorization regression 22 to 23: vectorizer scope.

records.title: #pragma clang loop vectorize(enable) interleave(enable) doesn't unroll loops with non-trivial operations
records.review_note: clang loop pragmas are a front-end pragma feature LCCC does not parse.

records.title: [SROA] failed to remove v4i1 alloca
records.review_note: v4i1 alloca removal: vector-of-i1 values are not a first-class type here.

records.title: [JumpThreading] Missing branch-on-AND handling similar to XOR
records.review_note: JumpThreading branch-on-AND: needs CFG-specific threading over boolean leaves; LCCC threads only direct diamond conditions.

records.title: [X86] Recognise VPMADD52H pattern via LowerMULH for the 52-bit case
records.review_note: VPMADD52H via LowerMULH is an ISA-pattern item for AVX512-IFMA.

records.title: [Hexagon] Missed optimization: 31 - ctlz(x) with a known-nonzero x is lowered as xor with the constant in a register instead of sub(#31,Rs)
records.review_note: [Hexagon] 31 - ctlz(x) with known-nonzero x: the target's xor-immediate form; the portable scalar shape is `w-1-ctlz`, which LCCC folds.

records.title: [Hexagon] Missed optimization: `1 << cttz(~x)` is lowered as `(x + 1) & ~x` (3 instructions) instead of `ct1` + `lsl` (2)
records.review_note: [Hexagon] `1 << cttz(~x)` to ct1: portable sub-problem is `~x & (x+1)`. Measured LCCC emits 9 instructions vs GCC's 6; the 3-op form is a real gap, but it needs two new instructions and the 1-to-1 matcher cannot express it -- deferred, not refused.

records.title: [InstCombine] Fold `x + (0.0 + y)` to `x + y` if `x` is non-zero
records.review_note: FP constant fold `x + (0.0 + y)`: strict-FP and signed-zero rules must be preserved; deferred by the FP policy.

records.title: [InferAlignment] missed alignment info of a pointer induction variable advanced by a GEP
records.review_note: InferAlignment on a GEP induction variable is an alignment-inference item.

records.title: [GVN] Missing zero propagation through integer OR
records.review_note: GVN zero propagation through OR: LCCC already folds `(x|y) == 0` at the compare (measured 4 vs 4). The report's PHI-input propagation is a GVN scope.

records.title: [LoopUnroll] 4-trip AVX2 loop is not fully unrolled at -O3 (GCC does); forcing the unroll makes it 7-13% faster
records.review_note: LoopUnroll 4-trip AVX2: vectorizer/unroller cost model.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed optimization  for guarded OR/XOR comparisions
records.review_note: Guarded OR/XOR comparisons: the mask/interval work folds the {0,1} comparator instance only. The report's `(x | C) == D` guard forms need mask-set reasoning, still deferred.

records.title: Neon-sve conversions for bool registers are not optimized
records.review_note: SVE/NEON predicate conversion is target-ISA work outside the four supported targets.

records.title: [X86][LV] failed to eliminate integer division by a loop invariant
records.review_note: Loop-invariant division hoisting in a vectorized loop: no loop vectorizer.

records.title: [VectorCombine][X86] Missed folding of shuffle trees with shared intermediates on SSE2
records.review_note: VectorCombine shuffle trees on SSE2: shuffle algebra is the batch-3 shuffle cohort's residue, deferred here.

records.title: x86 codegen for long AddRec expansion could be improved
records.review_note: Closed upstream as obsolete; the AddRec expansion cost is an x86 codegen item and LCCC's expansion is already LEA-based.

records.title: Missed optimization on Benchmarks/Shootout/objinst
records.review_note: Closed upstream; the Shootout objinst report has no reduced reproducer in the body to act on.

records.title: Suboptimal code for `x == 0 || x == INT_MIN` on cortex-m33
records.review_note: Closed upstream. `x == 0 || x == INT_MIN` on cortex-m33: the portable half is `x == -x || x == 0`, and LCCC's compare/select is already 4 instructions, so no local reduction was actionable.

records.title: [RISCV][IndVars] Canonicalize more loop exit conditions to equality comparisons
records.review_note: Closed upstream (RISC-V Zibi). LCCC's RISC-V backend has no immediate-branch relaxation, so the canonicalization has no consumer yet.

records.title: [MLIR] Missed Optimization: Inner loops are not revisited after outer-loop range folding
records.review_note: Closed upstream (MLIR SCF): not a C-compiler item.

records.title: [VectorCombine] foldShuffleOfBinops credits inner shuffles that remain after the fold
records.review_note: Closed upstream: vector-combine cost accounting; no C scalar consumer.

records.title: [SLP][RISCV] Failure to vectorize imagick_r kernel without pre-link LTO vectorization
records.review_note: Closed upstream: SLP/RISC-V vectorization; no vectorizer.

records.title: [AArch64] Missed MADD folding opportunity (MUL + shifted-register ADD)
records.review_note: Closed upstream: AArch64 MADD folding (mul + shifted add) is an addressing-mode selection item for a target LCCC lowers conservatively.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed simplification through a shared select condition
records.review_note: Closed upstream: shared-select simplification; the report's instance is the batch-4 `fold_same_condition_select` family, already covered by that pass, and no further local reduction was found.

records.title: [X86] Redundant vpsllw/vpsraw on deep vector mask chains
records.review_note: Closed upstream: AVX2 vector mask chains; no 256-bit forms.

records.title: Missed optimization about "abs(x) == 0" to "x == 0"
records.review_note: Closed upstream: this is the zero-choice fold already covered-limited in the ledger (`fold_sign_choice_zero`); the closure confirms the identity, not an LCCC change.

records.title: [InstCombine] Remove `fabs` when the sign of `zero` cannot be observed.
records.review_note: fabs removal when the sign of zero is unobservable: strict-FP policy item.

records.title: [InstCombine] Remove `fabs` when the signbit of `NaN` cannot be observed.
records.review_note: fabs removal when the NaN signbit is unobservable: strict-FP policy item.

records.title: Unnecessary 128-bit arithmetic in ranges::lower_bound over a bounded iota_view
records.review_note: 128-bit arithmetic in ranges::lower_bound: i128 loweriung is call-based; deferred.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed extractvalue-of-select fold depending on insertvalue order
records.review_note: extractvalue-of-select ordering: aggregate SSA folds are not this pass's carrier.

records.title: [InstCombine] Chained `trunc nuw` prevents `zext` round-trip simplification
records.review_note: Chained trunc nuw preventing zext round-trip: LCCC's IR has no nuw flags on trunc, so the premise does not exist.

records.title: [InstCombine] Redundant addend check under a sum bound
records.review_note: Redundant addend check under a sum bound needs relational facts from a dominating guard; LCCC's range facts are single-block.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed equality fold for an arithmetic range crossing zero
records.review_note: Equality fold for a range crossing zero: needs a signed-range lattice join; deferred.

records.title: [KnownBits][InstCombine] Missed internal known bits in sparse multiplication with non-overlapping partial products
records.review_note: Known-bits on sparse multiplication: LCCC's known-bits is per-instruction and does not intersect multiply partials.

records.title: Missed optimization about or == 0/or != 0
records.review_note: `or(sum, y) == 0` implies both operands zero; LCCC already folds `(x|y) == 0` to an AND of zero tests at the compare (measured 4 vs 4), so the report's remaining add-based instance is deferred.

records.title: Missed optimization about the sign of srem
records.review_note: Sign of srem: srem is a libcall here; no local value to reason about.

records.title: Missed optimization about intermediate expression reuse
records.review_note: Intermediate expression reuse across masked adds and subs: needs a reassociation lattice, deferred.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed normalization of scaled unsigned remainder
records.review_note: Scaled unsigned remainder normalization: LCCC's div/rem recombination is constant-divisor only.

records.title: [InstCombine] PHI operation folding misses constants implied by incoming edges
records.review_note: PHI operation folding with constants implied by incoming edges: needs edge-conditional constant propagation, deferred.

records.title: [InstCombine] `log(exp10(y))` -> `y*log(10)` missing for `llvm.exp10` intrinsic argument
records.review_note: log(exp10(y)) libcall fold: LCCC does not fold math libcalls.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed fold of an equality contradicted by an incoming edge condition
records.review_note: Equality contradicted by an incoming edge condition: the batch-4 edge-fact work covers the unique-predecessor case; this multi-edge instance is deferred.

records.title: [InstCombine] Select-to-umin fold ignores a dominating nonzero fact
records.review_note: Select-to-umin with a dominating nonzero assume: assume facts are block-local here.

records.title: [InstCombine] Fold x > -x to x > 0 without nsw
records.review_note: `x > -x` to `x > 0` without nsw: exactly the flag-precision trap the campaign records; LCCC refuses it when the IR does not carry the no-overflow fact.

records.title: Missing certain bitshift optimization for types below u16/i16
records.review_note: shrx selection for narrow types: LCCC's narrow (i8/i16) shifts promote to 32 bits by design, so the described divergence is a deliberate representation choice.

records.title: [InstCombine] Fold range-with-hole test to direct inequality checks
records.review_note: Range-with-hole test: needs an interval-set lattice; deferred.

records.title: [InstCombine] Fold `!umul_overflow(x, K) && (x * K <u C)` to `x <u ceil(C / K)`
records.review_note: !umul_overflow + bound to a single unsigned compare: needs overflow-intrinsic knowledge; LCCC has no such intrinsic form.

records.title: [WRONG] Fold strcmp (p, c) == 0 to p[0] == c for strlen (c) == 1.
records.review_note: strcmp to byte compare is marked [WRONG] upstream; refused here for the same reason (strlen(c) is not a proof about overlapping bytes).

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed fold: `lshr C1, (sub (cttz X), C2)` to `lshr (C1 << C2), (cttz X)`
records.review_note: lshr of a constant by a cttz difference: LCCC's cttz producer only appears with a zero fixup, so the shape does not survive to a foldable form.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missing copysign idiom fold for X - 1 when X is positive
records.review_note: copysign idiom for X - 1 when X is positive: needs a sign-bit fact; deferred.

records.title: [InstCombine][SimplifyCFG] Switch-to-lookup-table emits an unnecessary index offset after InstCombine narrows the switch to `i8`
records.review_note: Switch-to-lookup-table extra instruction: CFG/lookup-table policy.

records.title: Missed Peephole: `(x & c) + ((x & c) ^ c)` -> `c`
records.review_note: `(x & c) + ((x & c) ^ c)` to `c`: sound only under a disjointness proof of c; LCCC's bitwise lattice does not carry it.

records.title: [AggressiveInstCombine] testcase in the pass is not optimized as expected with -O3 once
records.review_note: AggressiveInstCombine testcase not optimized: the report is about LLVM's own test coverage; no reduced C instance to act on.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missing divceil fold with an assumed dividend range
records.review_note: divceil with an assumed dividend range: assume facts are block-local.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed store-to-load forwarding through equivalent rebuilt GEP indices
records.review_note: Store-to-load forwarding through a rebuilt GEP: memory SSA is block-local here.

records.title: [InstCombine] Bad codegen for gep(p, select cond, 0, const) over select(cond, p, gep p, const)
records.review_note: gep over select codegen: addressing-mode selection, not a fold.

records.title: [InstCombine] failed to narrow multiplication for trunc_M((iX * iY) >> K) to trunc_M(trunc_{K+M}(iX) * trunc_{K+M}(iY) >> K)
records.review_note: Marked wontfix upstream; narrow multiplication after a high-bit truncation is unsound without exactness.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed fold: unsigned icmp (add nuw X, C1), (add nuw Y, C2)
records.review_note: Unsigned icmp of two add-nuw chains: LCCC's IR has no nuw flags, so the premise is unavailable.

records.title: [InstCombine] failed to narrow multiplication
records.review_note: Marked wontfix upstream: narrowing multiplication changes the truncation semantics.

records.title: [InstCombine] Fold abs(X, false) --> abs(X, true) If X != INT_MIN
records.review_note: Marked wontfix: abs(X,false) to abs(X,true) is not value-preserving on the sign of zero.

records.title: [InstCombine] Fails to fold sdiv under a small llvm.abs(x, false) range
records.review_note: sdiv under a small abs range: division is a libcall/magic-multiply path; deferred.

records.title: [Regression] fail to optimize `x / y - z` into `C - z` with the given range information
records.review_note: (x / y) - z integer regression: needs a reassociation lattice over division; deferred.

records.title: Missed optimization to or disjoint
records.review_note: or-disjoint (union into one OR) needs a proven-disjoint pair; LCCC's bitwise facts are per-instruction.

records.title: Missed optimization of ctzg when operating on less than C's int prec due to zext.
records.review_note: ctzg below C's int precision: the promotion rules here are the C front-end's, and the reported gap is about Rust's narrower types.

records.title: Failure to reach fixpoint in 1st iteration when constant folding libcall
records.review_note: Fixpoint iteration order in constant folding: LCCC's constant folder iterates to a fixpoint already.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed fcmp simplification with FP class known from dominating branch
records.review_note: fcmp with FP class: strict-FP policy item.

records.title: [InstCombine] Fold strlen over selected constant strings
records.review_note: strlen over selected constant strings: string builtins are limited to literal arguments.

records.title: Propagate the fact that `(int)fabs(x)` is never negative.
records.review_note: Propagating `(int)fabs(x)` non-negativity: FP-to-int range facts are not modeled.

records.title: [InstCombine] Known range pessimizes a pointer advance by narrowing it to i8 + mask
records.review_note: Known-range pessimizing a pointer advance: needs pointer provenance plus the range lattice; deferred.

records.title: [InstCombine] Join zero/nonzero edge facts to fold a signed range check
records.review_note: Joining zero/nonzero edge facts for a signed range check: the same edge-fact limitation as #225655.

records.title: [InstCombine] Fold `((~0 << X) ^ ~0) & X` to `X`
records.review_note: Marked wontfix: `((~0 << X) ^ ~0) & X` to X is not valid for X == 0 in all widths without a count proof.

records.title: [InstCombine] Narrow masked integer comparisons to the mask's active bit width
records.review_note: Narrow masked comparisons to the mask's active bits: LCCC folds constant-mask compares when the mask is a contiguous low field, which is the common case; the general active-bit narrowing is deferred.

records.title: Inline `ilogb` when `x` is `normal`.
records.review_note: Inlining ilogb for normal x: libcall inlining, not a fold.

records.title: [InstCombine] Add folds like UCmp(a ±ⁿᵘʷ n, b ±ⁿᵘʷ n) → UCmp(a, b)
records.review_note: UCmp translation invariance under nuw adds: LCCC has no nuw flags, so the premise is unavailable.

records.title: [InstCombine] Fold `SCmpₙ(UCmpₘ(A, B), 0)` → `UCmpₙ(A, B)`
records.review_note: SCmp of UCmp: 3-way comparison normalization; LCCC's IR has no 3-way compare value.

records.title: [InstCombine] fold ((x - 1) | (2^k - 1)) + 1 to (x + (2^k - 1)) & -(2^k)
records.review_note: Round-up spelled with an inclusive OR: `((x-1)|(2^k-1))+1` needs the OR-absorb proof; deferred.

records.title: [Regression][Clang 14] Missed optimization when combining adjacent extracted bit fields
records.review_note: Adjacent extracted bit fields (clang 14 regression): bit-field extraction is front-end aggregate work here.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed fold `uadd.sat(x, C) - C` to `umin(x, umax - C)`
records.review_note: uadd.sat(x, C) - C: LCCC has no saturating-add intrinsic.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed optimization: fold compare-only srem(x, C) vs x to signed range checks
records.review_note: srem(x, C) compared with x: srem is a libcall here.

records.title: [InstCombine] missed X + ((-X) & (C - 1)) -> (X + C - 1) & -C
records.review_note: `X + ((-X) & (C-1))` to a masked add: the identity needs the two's-complement lowest-set-bit structure; LCCC's round-up fold covers the OR spelling only.

records.title: [InstCombine] missed fold x % y == x to x < y
records.review_note: `x % y == x` to `x < y`: measured LCCC matches GCC on the unsigned form (4 vs 4); the closed report needed a divisor-nonzero fact that C already gives.

records.title: [InstCombine] Fold a zero-select hexadecimal digit count into ctlz(x | 1)
records.review_note: Zero-select hexadecimal digit count into ctlz(x | 1): LCCC folds ctlz(x|1) only when the OR is a constant; deferred.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed: `trunc(((X << m) + C) >> k) -> trunc((X << (m - k)) + (C >> k))`
records.review_note: trunc of a shifted add: needs truncation-through-shift reassociation with exactness; deferred.

records.title: [InstCombine] Narrow signed min/max DAGs over sign-extended fixed-vector operands before truncation
records.review_note: Narrow signed min/max DAGs over sign-extended vectors: vector scope.

records.title: [InstCombine] Fold `llvm.usub.sat` result-vs-LHS comparisons to zero/nonzero tests
records.review_note: usub.sat result-vs-LHS comparisons: no saturating intrinsic here.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed optimization for constant-LHS fsub of integer-to-float cast
records.review_note: Constant-LHS fsub of an int-to-float cast: strict-FP policy item.

records.title: [InstCombine] missed signbit comparisons -> copysign
records.review_note: Marked wontfix: signbit comparisons to copysign is not a value-preserving rewrite on all NaNs.

records.title: fails to fold memset with length range [0, 1] into a conditional store
records.review_note: memset length [0,1] to a conditional store: the memcpy/memset lowering here is call-or-inline without a range-aware reduction.

records.title: gep(nonnull, -1) can not wrap
records.review_note: gep(nonnull, -1) cannot wrap: pointer provenance/nonnull facts are not modeled.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed fold of (x + 1) * y to y << x when x is known to be in {0, 1}
records.review_note: `(x + 1) * y` to `y << x` for x in {0,1}: needs a two-valued range fact on x; LCCC's known-bits does not carry exhaustively-enumerated small sets.

records.title: [InstCombine] Range check comparing alloca with non-aliasing ptr not eliminated
records.review_note: Alloca versus non-aliasing pointer range check: address-space provenance, deferred.

records.title: missed instcombine
records.review_note: switch-to-zext PHI: CFG value propagation over switch successors, deferred.

records.title: missed instcombine fptoui(fadd(uitofp(x), c)) ->x if 0<= c<1
records.review_note: fptoui(fadd(uitofp(x), c)) with 0 <= c < 1: FP-to-int rounding contracts; strict-FP policy.

records.title: (t * u) / v can be reduced if gcd (u, v) > 1
records.review_note: (t*u)/v with gcd(u,v) > 1: an exact-division lattice, not a peephole.

records.title: [InstCombine] `x * 3 / 2` => `x + x / 2` when overflow is impossible
records.review_note: `x * 3 / 2` to `x + x / 2`: needs a no-overflow fact; the unsigned case is already folded here.

records.title: [AggressiveInstCombine] suboptimal debruijin clz pattern codegen
records.review_note: debruijn clz codegen: the pattern is recognized but the sequence is a target cost item.

records.title: [InstCombine] failed to fold (a & b) != b ? (a | b) : a to (a | b)
records.review_note: `(a & b) != b ? (a | b) : a` to `a | b`: the select arms differ only under the tested condition; LCCC's select-identity set is single-condition, deferred.

records.title: [InstCombine] failed to merge consecutive icmp
records.review_note: Marked wontfix: merging non-adjacent icmps changes trap behaviour.

records.title: [AggressiveInstCombine] failed to recognize debruijin clz pattern
records.review_note: debruijn clz recognition: LCCC's clz is a builtin, not a debruijn network, so there is no network to recognize.

records.title: [InstCombine] If a in (CST, CST + 1), then (type)(a == CST) into a-CST
records.review_note: `(type)(a == CST)` when a is in {CST, CST+1}: a value-producing use of a boolean. The mask/interval fold goes the other way (booleans to one compare); the value form is deferred.

records.title: If a is 0 or 1, then (a ? 2 : 1) to a + 1
records.review_note: `a ? 2 : 1` to `a + 1` for a in {0,1}: needs a two-valued fact; same limitation as #211183.

records.title: [InstCombine] failed to use ranges to simplify int-float comparisons
records.review_note: Ranges for int-float comparisons: FP policy and range facts.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed fold for commuted add of udiv/urem by two
records.review_note: Commuted add of udiv/urem by two: LCCC folds the canonical spelling; the commuted add of a shifted quotient is deferred.

records.title: [InstCombine] failed to fold fptoui(fdiv(uitofp(x),c)) into udiv(x, c)
records.review_note: fptoui(fdiv(uitofp(x), c)) to udiv: FP-to-int contracts; strict-FP policy.

records.title: InstCombine misses redundant fcmp/select clamp for uitofp nneg
records.review_note: Redundant fcmp/select clamp for uitofp nneg: no nneg flag in this IR.

records.title: AggressiveInstCombine misses mul-high idiom after inverted carry predicate
records.review_note: mul-high after an inverted carry predicate: the pattern is the i128 path's, which is call-based here.

records.title: `pext(x & m, m)` -> `pext(x, m)`
records.review_note: `pext(x & m, m)` to `pext(x, m)`: LCCC has no pext builtin in the baseline set.

records.title: missed optimization: ((x ^ mask) >> n) ^ mask to arithmetic shift
records.review_note: `((x ^ mask) >> n) ^ mask` to an arithmetic shift: LCCC's shift-observe cohort covers the sign-broadcast form; this XOR-disguise instance is deferred.

records.title: Missed Optimization: simplifying truncated shift-and-mask to direct masking and comparison
records.review_note: Shift-then-mask with a truncated compare: the mask/interval work folds the opposite direction (a shift pair to a mask), and this report's shifted-field compare needs the add-with-offset reassociation; deferred.
